notes.subject: bek bilong yu
notes.rationale: גוך is 'back' (ASV/JPS 'your back'); KJV reads 'your body'.

notes.subject: bel bilong yu
notes.rationale: נפשך is life-force/breath, rendered with 'bel' (inner self) rather than 'soul'.

notes.subject: ונעברה / לעברים
notes.rationale: Same root עבר 'pass over': 'that we may pass over' and 'to them that pass by' — the trampling image repeats, hard to keep in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: מוגיך
notes.rationale: Root יגה 'to afflict/grieve'; some render 'those who crushed you' versus 'who made you bow down', tying to the bowing image.

translation: Na mi bai putim em long han bilong ol man i givim pen long yu, ol i tok long bel bilong yu: Pundaun, bilong yumi ken go antap; na yu putim bek bilong yu olsem graun, na olsem rot bilong ol man i wokabaut i go antap.

tokens.gloss: bilong ol man i givim pen long yu
bilong ol man i wokabaut i go antap
